recommendations.Resource Management: Obtain written commitment from resource managers confirming team availability through hypercare completion, with escalation protocol if resource conflicts arise
recommendations.Knowledge Continuity: Establish cross-training plan ensuring at least two team members are proficient in each critical technical area and operational procedure
recommendations.Transition Planning: Define hypercare support model including on-call rotation, issue triage process, and escalation paths before go-live to ensure production support readiness regardless of team composition changes

predictedRisks.responseRationale: Extended timeline through October 30 without formal contract amendment creates resource allocation ambiguity. Historical evidence shows governance drift without documented resource continuity planning. With critical phases executing post-contract end date and distributed team across USA and India, formal resource commitment confirmation is essential to prevent disruption during PAT, regression, deployment, and hypercare.
